accounting: 68 pinned original instances. adapted-test-passed means native assertion adaptation verified; platform-not-applicable and partial are not original passes. Many originals may map to one native mechanism test. Native probes below add no original instances.

independentProbes.purpose: Typed native compiler exception is used by real production watcher error pipeline, not only dictionary diagnostic unit calls.
Real HMR -> CLR resolver -> Loader bad async DLL rollback, latest public Entry options vs stale raw Fiber config, direct fibers, resources, subsequent replacement, ALC collection.
Resolver generation additions publish; remapping requests restart before live code changes.
No hidden watcher daemon when HMR is omitted.

Actual CLR replacement callback resolves old and another module without holding the state gate; external Dispose waits until switch commit; nested replacement/self-disposal reject instead of deadlocking; every owned ALC is collected.

parameterEvidence: Theory references use exact current TRX testName strings. Native theory declaration totals are recorded separately; mapping multiple original ModuleLoader-layout parameters to a single native Fact is a documented language/runtime adaptation, not extra native executions.
